```{r}
gabon_union <- st_union(shp_gabon)

spatial_data_gab <- spatial_data_gab %>% st_transform(3857)

spatial_data_gab_sp     <- as(spatial_data_gab, "Spatial")
gabon_union_sp <- as(gabon_union, "Spatial")

coords_gabon<- coordinates(spatial_data_gab_sp)


mesh_gabon <- inla.mesh.2d(
  loc      = coords_gabon,
  boundary = inla.sp2segment(gabon_union_sp),
  max.edge = c(25e3, 200e3),   
  cutoff   = 70e3,
  offset   = c(100e3, 200e3))

# Extract triangle vertex indices
tri <- mesh_gabon$graph$tv


# Build edges from triangles
edges_list <- list()

for (i in 1:nrow(tri)) {
  idx <- tri[i, ]
  # Each triangle has 3 edges
  edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1]] <- st_linestring(mesh_gabon$loc[idx[c(1,2)], 1:2])
  edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1]] <- st_linestring(mesh_gabon$loc[idx[c(2,3)], 1:2])
  edges_list[[length(edges_list) + 1]] <- st_linestring(mesh_gabon$loc[idx[c(3,1)], 1:2])
}

mesh_edges_sf <- st_as_sf(st_sfc(edges_list, crs = 3857))

coords_df_gabon <- as.data.frame(coords_gabon)
colnames(coords_df_gabon) <- c("X", "Y")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = mesh_edges_sf, fill = NA, color = "grey60", size = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = gabon_union, fill = NA, color = "black", size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = coords_df_gabon, aes(X, Y), color = "red", size = 1.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("Mesh for Gabon with Boundary")

```

```{r}
spde_Gabon <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
  mesh = mesh_gabon,
  prior.range = c(5000, 0.5),
  prior.sigma = c(0.15, 0.5))

A_est <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh_gabon, loc = coords_gabon)

#1. Variables to be scale
vars_to_scale <- c(
  "vegetation_index",
  "pop_density_2020",
  "annual_temperature_2021",
  "annual_rainfall_2021",
  "elevation",
  "annual_ITN_usage_2021",
  "dist_to_water",
  "lc_water",
  "lc_trees",
  "lc_built",
  "lc_cropland",
  "lc_wetland")

# 2. Create a named list to store the training parameters (Means and SDs)
scaling_stats <- list()

# 3. Scale the observed data and extract the parameters
for (var in vars_to_scale) {
  # Calculate mean and standard deviation from the 36 observed points
  mean_val <- mean(spatial_data_gab[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  sd_val   <- sd(spatial_data_gab[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Store them for later use on the grid
  scaling_stats[[var]] <- c(mean = mean_val, sd = sd_val)
  
  # Apply the scaling to the observed data
  spatial_data_gab[[var]] <- (spatial_data_gab[[var]] - mean_val) / sd_val
  }
```

```{r}

gabon_union_sp <- as(gabon_union, "Spatial")

# coords_gabon <- coordinates(spatial_data_gab_sp)
spatial_data_gab$lon <- coords_gabon[,1]
spatial_data_gab$lat <- coords_gabon[,2]
#-----------------------------------------------------------
# BUILD ONE GLOBAL MESH
#-----------------------------------------------------------

mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(
  loc      = coords_gabon,
  boundary = inla.sp2segment(gabon_union),
  max.edge = c(25e3, 200e3),   
  cutoff   = 70e3,
  offset   = c(100e3, 200e3))


#-----------------------------------------------------------
# DEFINE SPDE MODEL
#-----------------------------------------------------------

spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(
  mesh = mesh,
  prior.range = c(5000, 0.5),
  prior.sigma = c(0.15, 0.5))

s.index <- inla.spde.make.index(
  name = "spatial",
  n.spde = spde$n.spde)
#=========================================================
# CANDIDATE MODELS
#=========================================================

candidate_models <- list(

  Model1 = c(
    "annual_rainfall_2021",
    "annual_temperature_2021",
    "vegetation_index",
    "dist_to_water",
    "lc_trees",
    "lc_built",
    "pop_density_2020"),

  Model2 = c(
    "annual_rainfall_2021",
    "dist_to_water",
    "pop_density_2020",
    "lc_built"))

#=========================================================
# RANDOM 3-FOLD CV FUNCTION
#=========================================================

run_random_cv <- function(data, covariates, mesh, spde, s.index){

  set.seed(123)

  data$random_fold <- sample(rep(1:2, length.out = nrow(data)))

  folds <- 1:2

  fold_results <- list()

  for(i in folds){

    cat("\n=====================================\n")

    cat("LEAVING OUT RANDOM FOLD:", i, "\n")

    cat("=====================================\n")

    train <- data %>%
      filter(random_fold != i)

    test <- data %>%
      filter(random_fold == i)

    train <- st_drop_geometry(train)

    test <- st_drop_geometry(test)

    #-----------------------------------------------------
    # A MATRICES
    #-----------------------------------------------------

    A_train <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = as.matrix(train[,c("lon","lat")]))

    A_test <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = as.matrix(test[,c("lon","lat")]))

    #-----------------------------------------------------
    # DYNAMIC EFFECTS
    #-----------------------------------------------------

    train_effects <- data.frame(intercept = rep(1, nrow(train)))
      
    test_effects <- data.frame(intercept = rep(1, nrow(test)))

    for(v in covariates){

      train_effects[[v]] <- train[[v]]

      test_effects[[v]] <- test[[v]]
    }

    #-----------------------------------------------------
    # STACKS
    #-----------------------------------------------------

    stack.est <- inla.stack(

      data = list(y = train$Number_of_infected_tot_pm,
        Ntrials = train$Number_of_participant_tot),

      A = list(A_train, 1),

      effects = list(spatial = s.index, train_effects),

      tag = "est")

    stack.pred <- inla.stack(

      data = list(y = NA, Ntrials = test$Number_of_participant_tot),

      A = list(A_test, 1),

      effects = list(spatial = s.index, test_effects),

      tag = "pred")

    stk <- inla.stack(stack.est, stack.pred)

    #-----------------------------------------------------
    # FORMULA
    #-----------------------------------------------------

    fixed_terms <- paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")

    formula <- as.formula(paste0("y ~ -1 + intercept + ", fixed_terms,
                                 " + f(spatial, model = spde)"))

    #-----------------------------------------------------
    # MODEL FIT
    #-----------------------------------------------------

    fit <- inla(

      formula,

      family = "betabinomial",

      data = inla.stack.data(stk),

      Ntrials =inla.stack.data(stk)$Ntrials,

      control.predictor = list(
        A = inla.stack.A(stk),
        compute = TRUE),

      control.fixed = list(
        mean = 0,
        prec = 0.2),

      control.compute = list(
        dic = TRUE,
        waic = TRUE,
        cpo = TRUE,
        config = TRUE))

    #-----------------------------------------------------
    # POSTERIOR SAMPLING
    #-----------------------------------------------------

    idx.pred <- inla.stack.index(stk, "pred")$data

    samples <- inla.posterior.sample(100, fit)
    
    eta_mat <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(
    function(idx) APredictor[idx],
    samples,
    idx = idx.pred
    )

    prob_mat <- plogis(eta_mat)

    pred_mean <- rowMeans(prob_mat)

    pred_lower <- apply(prob_mat, 1, quantile, 0.025)

    pred_upper <- apply(prob_mat, 1, quantile,0.975)

    #-----------------------------------------------------
    # OBSERVED PREVALENCE
    #-----------------------------------------------------

    obs_prev <- test$Number_of_infected_tot_pm / test$Number_of_participant_tot

    #-----------------------------------------------------
    # METRICS
    #-----------------------------------------------------

    rmse <- sqrt(mean((obs_prev - pred_mean)^2, na.rm = TRUE))

    mae <- mean(abs(obs_prev - pred_mean), na.rm = TRUE)

    cor_val <- cor(obs_prev, pred_mean, use = "complete.obs")

    coverage <- mean(
      obs_prev >= pred_lower &
      obs_prev <= pred_upper,
      na.rm = TRUE)

    fold_results[[i]] <- data.frame(

      DIC = fit$dic$dic,

      WAIC =fit$waic$waic,

      LogCPO = mean(log(fit$cpo$cpo),na.rm = TRUE),

      RMSE =rmse,

      MAE =mae, Correlation = cor_val, Coverage95 = coverage)
  }

  fold_results <- do.call(rbind, fold_results)

  means  <- sapply(fold_results, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  lower <- sapply(fold_results,
                  function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)))

  upper <- sapply(fold_results,
                  function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)))
    
  as.data.frame(t(c(means,
      setNames(lower, paste0(names(lower), "_L")),
      setNames(upper, paste0(names(upper), "_U")))))
}

#=========================================================
# RUN ALL MODELS
#=========================================================

model_comparison <- lapply(names(candidate_models),

  function(m){

    cat("\n\n=================================\n")

    cat("RUNNING", m, "\n" )

    cat("=================================\n")

    res <- run_random_cv(data = spatial_data_gab,

      covariates = candidate_models[[m]], mesh = mesh, spde = spde,

      s.index = s.index)

    data.frame( Model = m, res)
  })

#=========================================================
# FINAL MODEL COMPARISON TABLE
#=========================================================

model_comparison <- do.call(
  rbind,
  model_comparison)

print(model_comparison)
```

```{r}
grid_sf_gabon <- grid_sf_gabon %>% 
  rename(annual_rainfall_2021 = rainfall,
         annual_temperature_2021 = temperature,
         pop_density_2020        = pop_density,
         annual_ITN_usage_2021   = ITN_2011,
         lc_cropland             = landcover_cropland,
         lc_trees                = landcover_trees,
         lc_wetland              = landcover_wetland,
         lc_water                = landcover_water,
         lc_built                = landcover_builts)

for (var in vars_to_scale) {
  mean_val <- scaling_stats[[var]]["mean"]
  sd_val   <- scaling_stats[[var]]["sd"]
  
  grid_sf_gabon[[var]] <- (grid_sf_gabon[[var]] - mean_val) / sd_val
}



A_pred <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = st_coordinates(grid_sf_gabon))

effects_pred <- data.frame(
    intercept               = 1,
    annual_rainfall_2021    = grid_sf_gabon$annual_rainfall_2021,
    pop_density_2020        = grid_sf_gabon$pop_density_2020,
    dist_to_water           = grid_sf_gabon$dist_to_water,
    lc_built                = grid_sf_gabon$lc_built)

stk_pred <- inla.stack(
    data = list(y = NA, Ntrials = NA),
    A = list(A_pred, 1),
    effects = list(
      spatial = 1:spde$n.spde,
      effects_pred),
    tag = "pred")

stk_full <- inla.stack(stk_est, stk_pred)
  

res_elevation <- inla(
  formular,
  family = "betabinomial",
  data = inla.stack.data(stk_full),
  Ntrials = inla.stack.data(stk_full)$Ntrials,
  control.predictor = list(
    A = inla.stack.A(stk_full),
    compute = TRUE,
    link    = 1
  ),
  control.fixed = list(
    mean = 0,
    prec = 0.2
  ),
  control.compute = list(dic = TRUE, waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE,
    config = TRUE)
)


pred_idx <- inla.stack.index(stk_full, "pred")$data

eta_mat <- inla.posterior.sample.eval(
  function() APredictor[pred_idx],
  inla.posterior.sample(100, res_elevation))

prob_mat <- plogis(eta_mat)

pred_mean <- rowMeans(prob_mat)
pred_sd   <- apply(prob_mat, 1, sd)
pred_q05  <- apply(prob_mat, 1, quantile, 0.025)
pred_q95  <- apply(prob_mat, 1, quantile, 0.975)


grid_sf_gabon$pred_mean <- pred_mean
grid_sf_gabon$pred_sd   <- pred_sd
grid_sf_gabon$pred_q05  <- pred_q05
grid_sf_gabon$pred_q95  <- pred_q95

```


```{r}

v1 <- vect(grid_sf_gabon)

template <- rast(
  ext = ext(v1),
  resolution = 5000,
  crs = crs(v1))


grid_sf_gabon_raster <- rasterize(
  v1,
  template,
  field = c("pred_mean", "pred_q05", "pred_q95"))

terra::plot(grid_sf_gabon_raster)
```
```{r}
vect_gab <- vect(shp_gab %>% st_transform(3857))
gab_pr_pm <- crop(grid_sf_gabon_raster, vect_gab)
gab_pr_pm <- mask(gab_pr_pm, vect_gab)
gab_pr_pm_df <- terra::extract(gab_pr_pm, vect_gab)
gab_pr_pm_df <- gab_pr_pm_df %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  mutate(pred_mean = mean(pred_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
         pred_q05  = mean(pred_q05, na.rm = TRUE),
         pred_q95  = mean(pred_q95, na.rm = TRUE),
         CI_width  = pred_q95 - pred_q05)%>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct()


gab_pr_pm_shp <- shp_gab %>% 
  mutate(PmPR     = gab_pr_pm_df$pred_mean,
         PmPR_L   = gab_pr_pm_df$pred_q05,
         PmPR_U   = gab_pr_pm_df$pred_q95,
         CI_width = gab_pr_pm_df$CI_width)
```


```{r}
gab_admin1 <- ggplot(gab_pr_pm_shp)+
  geom_sf(mapping = aes(fill = PmPR))+

       plot = gab_admin1, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

gab_admin2 <- ggplot(gab_pr_pm_shp)+
  geom_sf(mapping = aes(fill = CI_width))+
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "RdYlGn")),

    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Credible interval width",
    na.value = "transparent"
  )+
  theme_void()+
  labs(title = "Prevalence estimates uncertainty")

ggsave("Outputs/gab_output/Pf_pr_estimated/2021_gabon_pf_admin_level_uncertainty.png",
       plot = gab_admin2, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)


all_breaks <- c(0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1)

# Determine which intervals contain data
used_breaks <- all_breaks[
  all_breaks >= min(gab_pr_pm_shp$PmPR, na.rm = TRUE) &
  all_breaks <= max(gab_pr_pm_shp$PmPR, na.rm = TRUE)
]

ggplot(gab_pr_pm_shp) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = PmPR)) +
  scale_fill_stepsn(
    colours = rev(brewer.pal(5, "RdYlGn")),
    breaks = used_breaks,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    name = "Prevalence of FFV",
    na.value = "transparent"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Annual prevalence of FFV")
```
